qualifier: bidirectional regulation including xenophagy and phagophore targeting
name: Positive and negative regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation
rationale: All members regulate building or maturing autophagosomes (including protein recruitment to the phagophore and xenophagy), whereas confusables centre on cargo-selective autophagy types or autophagosome-lysosome fusion.

qualifier: spanning preinitiation, elongation braking, termination and R-loops
name: RNA polymerase II control from preinitiation to termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription steps from preinitiation complex assembly through elongation to poly(A)-coupled termination and R-loop processing, unlike confusables dominated by Pol I/III, rRNA, HIV elongation complexes or Polycomb chromatin programmes.

qualifier: endothelial morphogenesis with megakaryocyte-platelet and perivascular modules
name: Endothelial morphogenesis and megakaryocyte-platelet adhesion signalling
rationale: Most members concern endothelial morphogenesis, endothelial-matrix adhesion, perivascular stroma and platelet/myeloid adhesion signalling (plus several uncharacterised motif modules), distinguishing it from smooth-muscle, fibroblast-stroma and ER-secretory confusables.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: entry, genome replication, protein maturation and virion assembly across many viruses
name: Viral life cycle from host entry to virion assembly
rationale: Members cover attachment, entry, replication, translation, protein maturation and assembly of HIV, SARS-CoV, influenza, RSV, dengue and HCMV plus host modulation of these steps, while confusables focus on retroelement restriction, interferon sensing or viral transcription control only.

qualifier: centred on monocyte and dendritic cell surface receptors
name: Leukocyte surface signatures centred on monocytes and dendritic cells
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells, T cells and plasma cells (with butyrophilin interactions), whereas confusables emphasise lipid or MHC class II antigen presentation or T cell costimulation.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock response
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members concern HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and chaperone-dependent fates (aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, UPRmt), unlike confusables built on ER UPR, CCT folding, mitochondrial import or stress granules.

qualifier: disassembly-reassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi structural organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation, whereas confusables centre on COPI vesicle traffic, RHO GTPase cycles or constitutive secretion.

qualifier: synthesis and regulated uptake and release
name: Regulation of catecholamine synthesis, uptake and synaptic release
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine biosynthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous transmission, whereas confusables centre on monoamine transporters and their disease variants.

qualifier: AKT-FOXO and p53 with fructose-bisphosphate regulation
name: AKT-FOXO and p53 control of glycolytic flux
rationale: Members combine fructose-2,6/1,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate production with AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 metabolic signalling, unlike confusables driven by hypoxia/HIF or NRF2 or lacking the glycolytic arm.

qualifier: prostate and salivary gland via epithelial-mesenchymal signalling
name: Prostate and salivary gland branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signalling
rationale: Members concern gland budding, branching and epithelial differentiation in prostate, salivary gland and genitalia driven by reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling, distinguishing it from lung, pancreatic/kidney and female reproductive tract confusables.

core: Inherited renal amino acid transport defects
qualifier: imino acid and glycine transporters
name: Iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria from imino acid transporter defects
rationale: All three members are transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, unlike confusables covering cystinuria, hypouricemia, Hartnup disorder or hexose malabsorption.

core: Cullin neddylation and PD-L1 protein turnover
qualifier: tumour T cell immunity
name: Neddylation and PD-L1 degradation shaping anti-tumour T cell responses
rationale: Members combine neddylation/COP9 signalosome control of cullin ligases with post-translational processing and degradation of PD-L1 and T cell responses to tumour, whereas confusables lack neddylation or PD-L1 turnover.

qualifier: transepithelial and renal ion transport
name: Cellular osmotic response and epithelial sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members concern osmosensing, hypo- and hyperosmotic responses and transepithelial chloride and renal sodium transport, while confusables centre on cation-chloride cotransporter diseases, potassium handling or aldosterone/salt responses.

qualifier: bacterial toxin uptake and macrophage defence
name: Bacterial toxin uptake and macrophage host defence
rationale: Members loosely share host responses to pathogens: diphtheria and anthrax toxin entry, anti-leishmanial and anti-viral defence, CD163 macrophage responses and phagocyte NADPH oxidase, unlike confusables on bacterial invasion, mycobacterial evasion or respiratory burst regulation.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, direct alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation
name: Glycosylase base repair, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and cleavage, direct reversal of alkylation damage, NEIL3 cross-link resolution and TET-TDG demethylation, whereas confusables are restricted to BER gap-filling or specific glycosylase defects.

qualifier: reduced VEGF and FGF production and endothelial apoptosis
name: Endothelial growth restraint via reduced VEGF and FGF production
rationale: Members limit endothelial proliferation, tube formation and FGF chemotaxis, suppress VEGF and FGF production and promote endothelial apoptosis, whereas confusables concern sprouting angiogenesis promotion or VEGFR signalling inhibition.

core: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signalling
qualifier: with type III and type I interferon responses
name: IL-10, IL-12 family and type III interferon signalling
rationale: Members are IL-10/IL-20 and IL-12/23/27/35 family signalling plus type III interferon and interferon-alpha responses, distinguishing them from IL-17/IL-1 family, IFN-gamma and IL-15/IL-21 confusables.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-3 family cytokines and FLT3 with CBL control
name: STAT5 signalling by IL-2, IL-3 family cytokines and FLT3
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-3 and IL-5 signalling and FLT3 signalling with CBL-mediated attenuation converging on STAT5, unlike confusables centred on IL-15/IL-21, IL-6/CSF1, erythropoietin/thrombopoietin or Th2/mast cell cytokines.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT control of cell size
name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate calcineurin-NFAT signalling, cardiomyocyte growth, cell size and stress hypertrophy, whereas confusables concern skeletal muscle growth, atrophy, fibre-type switching or regeneration.

qualifier: ADP, thrombin, prostanoid and collagen GPVI receptors
name: Platelet activation through ADP, thrombin, prostanoid and collagen receptors
rationale: Members are agonist receptor pathways that set platelet activation (P2Y1/P2Y12, PARs, TP, prostacyclin receptor, GPVI, LDL sensitisation), while confusables emphasise G12/13-Rho signalling, degranulation or adhesion and coagulation.

qualifier: with host silencing of endogenous retroelements
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host silencing of retroelements
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration complex import, integration and circle formation together with APOBEC3G, KRAB-ZFP and HUSH restriction of retroelements, whereas confusables cover HIV entry and reverse transcription or HCMV latency.

qualifier: TRKA and NTRK3 to MAPK and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin signalling to MAPK and CREB
rationale: Members are NTF3-NTRK3 and TRKA adaptor signalling through Ras, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, p38 and CREB, distinguishing it from NGF retrograde/STAT3 and BDNF-NTRK2 confusables.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
qualifier: in touch, hearing and bladder smooth muscle
name: Potassium channel hyperpolarization in touch, hearing and bladder contraction
rationale: Members concern TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization, with physiological outputs in touch, outer hair cells and micturition, unlike confusables on TASK/TWIK/KATP channels or action potential propagation.

qualifier: aggregate clearance by aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ERAD
name: Misfolded protein clearance via aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through aggresome formation, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and endosomal microautophagy, reticulophagy and ERAD regulation, whereas confusables focus on ubiquitin-proteasome chain types or de novo folding.

qualifier: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, trafficking and clustering
name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking and clustering
rationale: Members cover AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, surface delivery, diffusion trapping and clustering in excitatory transmission, unlike confusables on CREB-linked long-term plasticity, presynaptic modulation or synaptic adhesion.
